name: Admin enters with Google and sees the private dashboard
description: Verifies the authorized administrator can sign in and access the protected KOVIAN Gestão dashboard.
steps: Open KOVIAN Gestão
Choose Entrar com Google
Authenticate as ruannpersonal@gmail.com
expected: The admin dashboard opens and displays the management sections; unauthorized accounts cannot access protected data.

name: Create and edit a student from mobile
description: Verifies mobile-friendly date and numeric inputs and that edited student data persists.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Alunos and create a student named Ana Teste
Edit Ana Teste and change the monthly fee
Save and refresh the list
expected: The edited monthly fee remains saved and the student can be found in the compact list.

name: Reject a student without a name
description: Verifies the form allows optional student details but requires a name.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Alunos and choose Novo cadastro
Leave Nome empty and save
expected: A required-name message is displayed and no student record is created.

name: Start a payment from a student row
description: Verifies the payment shortcut pre-fills the selected student, fee, due date and pending status without recording payment automatically.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Alunos
Choose Pagamento for Ana Teste
expected: The payment form opens with the student and monthly fee prefilled, status Pendente, and requires explicit saving.

name: Export the filtered records to CSV
description: Verifies the user can export the currently filtered records as a UTF-8 CSV file from a mobile device.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Alunos and search for a student
Choose Exportar CSV
expected: A CSV file downloads with the visible filtered records and Portuguese column labels.

name: Generate monthly charges without duplicates
description: Verifies the administrator can generate monthly pending charges and safely repeat the operation without duplicate charges for the same student and due month.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Pagamentos
Choose Gerar mensalidades do mês and confirm
Run the same action again for the same month
expected: Eligible active students receive one pending charge for the selected month; the second run creates no duplicate charges.

name: Delete a student with confirmation
description: Verifies deleting a student requires confirmation and removes the record from the list.
setup: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Create a student named Excluir Teste
steps: Choose Excluir for Excluir Teste
Confirm the deletion
Refresh the list
expected: Excluir Teste no longer appears in the student list.

name: Select a modality from the catalog on mobile
description: Verifies that the modality field uses the catalog selector rather than free-text entry and preserves an existing value when editing.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Alunos and choose Novo cadastro
Open Modalidade and select an option
Save, reopen the student and verify the selected modality
expected: The modality is selected from available catalog entries and remains saved after reopening the record.

name: Selecting a student fills payment details and lesson modality
description: Verifies that selecting an existing student speeds up payment and lesson entry without removing the ability to review fields before saving.
steps: Sign in as the authorized administrator
Open Pagamentos and choose Novo cadastro
Select an existing student
Verify the monthly fee is copied into Valor and a due date is suggested when empty
Open Aulas and choose Novo cadastro
Select a student who has a modality assigned
expected: Payment fields are prefilled from the selected student, and the lesson modality is filled from that student's record; the administrator can review and change values before saving.
